C0368.title: Cracking User Passwords with Hashcat in HTB Perfection Machine
C0368.summary: A March 2024 write-up of the HTB Perfection machine shows that after gaining a shell as user susan through SSTI injection, the tester found an SQLite database file in the user's home directory. The password hash was identified as SHA256; using the password-format rule leaked in email (first name, reversed first name, and random digits), Hashcat can combine a dictionary and mask attack to recover the credential.

references.title: HTB Perfection write-up: Ruby-based SSTI injection, use of password cracking tool hashcat
